title: Research: complete PR1122 nine-stage hosted invoice (no new kappa)
body:
PR1122's 10,652-ADD R439 word and PR1311's semantic-D bridge explicitly left the changed-word hosted invoice open. This package runs the fixed candidate through the unchanged nine-stage emitter and ownership auditor with PR589's frozen assignment, then binds the word, native records, templates, instruction digest and complete invoice.

The result hosts all **126,432 helper occurrences with zero banks** and emits **3,911,328 instructions**. The paid profile and bit saving remain PR589's. The actual prefix/two-level bounds use **176/390 bits**, charged at the existing **192/512 bits**. This closes the finite hosted-emission/invoice handoff; it supplies no new circuit or kappa and does not select a supplier.

Start at `research/r439-abc-hosted-invoice/README.md` and `RESULT.json`. Only the new package is added. Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; 53 pinned input/context files plus historical catalogue/selected provenance. Assignment seed 1, bit supplier, refined card `bit-helper-contract`. [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1796).

Validation on macOS arm64, Python 3.12.3, Apple Clang 21 and Boost 1.85:

- Complete registered verifier run directly: PASS, with fresh native 883/1,327-column checks, 6/18 omitted-bridge controls, 17 parent and 16 hosted mutations, and seven new receipt-binding controls. Final receipt matches canonical JSON exactly.
- Exact expanded invoice agrees with every statement of the unchanged adapted PR510 bit-invoice prelude. Its unrelated historical complex/outer loop is not run.
- Package metadata/source pins and the card's PR1062 positive example pass. No broad historical suite or selected cold replay was run.

Reproduce with Python 3.12, C++17 and Boost headers (set `BOOST_INCLUDE` if needed):

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-abc-hosted-invoice
```

Inherited common-frame/label, mutable-source, correlated-helper hosting, all-size compiler, precision/tape, recovery and analytic assumptions remain explicit. Maintainer acceptance of the semantic replacement is still separate. Original H2/K syntax is not weakened; the original-D bridge is checked unchanged. No current outer assembly or eleven-stage hosting claim is made.

Credit Gareth Davidson/PR1122, Arham Tahir/PR1311, woklerx/PR1194, the PR1062/967/1015/923 circuit lineage, DreamingOfClouds/PR589/510, eumemic/PR555/543 and the retained native/hosting/moment contributors. Prepared for Matthieu Pascal (@mtpsl) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

Final overlap refresh at 10:26–10:27 UTC covered 465 open PRs and 444 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; no matching hosted-invoice contribution was found beyond this claim and predecessor handoffs.
